Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Images are hidden until you allow them. Remote images let senders see when you open their email, so they now stay hidden. Use Load Images on a message, Always from a sender you trust, or switch to Always in Settings › General › Privacy.
  • Sign-in links and codes. Sign-in and verification emails show the code and the link at the top of the message, with Copy and Open buttons. New-mail notifications get Open Link and Copy Link too. The link's website is always shown.
  • Menu bar icon. See your unread count from the menu bar, open recent unread mail, write a new message or check for mail. Turn it off in Settings › General.
  • All Starred. With more than one account, see starred mail from every account in one place, under All Inboxes.

Security

  • Scripts inside emails no longer run, and an email can no longer redirect the reading pane to a web page.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • What's New. See what changed in each update from Help › What's New in Normal Mail. It also opens once by itself after Normal Mail updates.

Beta release — new features below are in beta. Please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • Archive. Clear conversations out of your Inbox without deleting them — toolbar button, Message › Archive (⌃⌘A), or press e. ⌘Z undoes it.
  • Keyboard shortcuts. j/k to move between conversations, e archive, # delete, s star, r/a/f reply / reply all / forward, c compose, / search, l labels, b snooze. Press ? for the full list; turn them off in Settings › General.
  • Labels. Labels now show their real names. Add, remove and create labels on a conversation with the + chip (or l), and rename or delete them from the sidebar.
  • Unsubscribe. A button next to the subject of mailing-list email unsubscribes you — in one click when the sender supports it.
  • Snooze. Hide a conversation until later today, tomorrow, the weekend, next week, or a time you pick. It comes back to your Inbox as unread.
  • Send Later. Schedule an email from the compose window. Scheduled emails wait in Drafts and are listed at the bottom of the sidebar.

Important: Snooze and Send Later need the app open

Snoozed conversations come back and scheduled emails send only while Normal Mail is open on your Mac. If the app is closed at that time, it happens the next time you open it. Normal Mail warns you if you quit with anything pending.

Bug fixes

  • Emails with an empty body (such as unsubscribe requests) can now be sent.
  • Multi-select delete can now be undone with ⌘Z.
